reply: ve forms (cos/sin of ωt, with or without state products) did not fit cleanly: the best frequency always sat at the edge of the scan, and time-decay forms also fell short. The time dependence looks non-sinusoidal, possibly a slow drift or a chirp, and I ran out of tool calls before I could test that.

best.code:
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*x + p[2]*v + p[3]*x**3
            + p[4]*t + p[5]*t*x + p[6]*t*x*x + p[7]*t*x**3
            + p[8]*t*t + p[9]*t*v)
